itemKeys: A few improvements have been done across the game's systems.
This is a small patch before our next large patch which will include several art and audio asset adjustments.
Thank you for your continued support, make sure to rate us and leave a review on the Play Store!
Fixed Strength's taunt failing to target properly
App icon adjusted on Android devices.
Fixed issue with screen size on Windows devices.
Added additional information to privacy policy.
Added several Italian translations that were missing before.
